text: ok one thing i would like to express so far with all the changes that have been made from my starting arguments to now is that while the code might be getting better behind the scenes, the ui is just getting worse. no awareness of horizontal width for example is one of the worst. im not saying this is the immediate next thing but the more you account for it now less we are doing later. also shallow capability surfaces like the objects is better organized but still just as useless if i cant do anything with the properties presented. so keep in mind, go for it
